messages.author: Priya Raman
messages.text: DE and FR localized versions of META-BRD-02 have been running 10 days. CTR is up ~6% vs the English version with subtitles, CPI is about the same. Not a big win, but they're cheap to make, so we'll keep them.

replies.author: Hana Kobayashi
replies.text: Lucas can do IT/ES versions too if we ever open those markets :wink:

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: Not in Q3. Six countries is enough for now.
